changes: Expanded INativeInputManagerRuntime with TryClearBindingOverrides while retaining the legacy void wrapper.
InputManager now returns false when runtime override clear cannot be proven.
InputManager TryClearBindingOverrides now initializes the runtime action asset before rejecting an early clear request.
ControlRemapper transactional load uses a no-throw try-clear helper before apply and rollback clear.
RebindingManager no longer publishes clear/load success unless runtime clear returns true.
RebindingManager ClearOverrides now captures current runtime overrides in a fixed rollback array before clearing.
RebindingManager ClearOverrides now restores runtime overrides when saved-file deletion fails.
RebindingManager now deletes the temp controls file before the primary controls.json file to avoid data loss on temp-delete failure.
AccessibilitySettings now routes OnDestroy through OnServiceShutdown to release cold GraphicsBuffer allocations.
Editor guard and regression test cover rejected clear without losing current overrides.
